h1: SEO audit for your online store
overview: We crawl your store and review it the way a search engine does, then check the things owners tend to miss: duplicate pages, thin product text, missing titles, broken links, slow templates and weak internal links. You receive a written report in plain English, with the biggest problems first and a short note on how to fix each one. You can hand the list to your developer, or order the fixes from us.

faq: What access do you need for the audit?
View access to Google Search Console is best, as it shows how Google sees your store. Without it, we still audit from the outside, but we cannot report indexing errors in detail.
Do you make the changes for me?
The audit itself is a report, so we do not change your store. If you want the fixes done, we quote them separately from the list, or give them to your own developer.
Will the audit tell me my keywords?
It points out obvious keyword gaps on your key pages. For a full keyword plan, choose our keyword research service, which goes into much more depth.
Which store platforms do you audit?
Shopify, WooCommerce, BigCommerce, Wix, Squarespace, Magento and custom sites. We tailor the fix notes to what your platform allows.
